intro.text: A resident of Hearthstone with at least two sons close to Kaladin's age.

items.text: In 1175 Jeber fell foul of the singer citylady Abiajan and was strung up and whipped. Lirin treated his wounds, angering Abiajan, and Jeber was chained in the basement of the citylord's manor. When the Fourth Bridge came to evacuate the town, Moash killed Jeber with his Honorblade, calling it mercy.
